sources.title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse is a non-thinking Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 69B total parameters and approximately 3B activated parameters per token. Built on LongCat-Flash-Lite, it replaces dense MLA with LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) and natively supports context lengths of up to 1M tokens.

sources.title: Meituan Ships a Lighter, Sparser LongCat-Flash
sources.snippet: Meituan has released LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse, a lighter and more sparsely activated variant of its LongCat-Flash family of large language models. The model is published on Hugging Face under a permissive MIT license, making it freely available for both research and commercial use.

sources.title: LongCat AI - LongCat-2.0 Trillion-Parameter Agentic Coding Model
sources.snippet: LongCat AI - Next-Generation Multi-Modal Models LongCat-2.0 leads our latest release — a 1.6T open-source MoE for agentic coding with native 1M context. Also explore LongCat-Next, Flash-Prover, Video-Avatar, and the full model family for reasoning, generation, and agents.

sources.title: Introducing LongCat-2.0
sources.snippet: To strengthen the model on long-horizon tasks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention and train LongCat-2.0 on hundreds of billions of tokens of 1M-context data. Together with dedicated post-training, this gives LongCat-2.0 strong performance on coding and agentic tasks.
